title: A sprint plan checks shared code by its behaviour, not its shape
goal: step 6 of the plan step of the kb-sprint skill tells the planner to give stories that change the same function checks on its behaviour, not on its internal shape, so a later story does not break an earlier done story's check; the plan rules that rag.py pack prints for the set kb-sprint:plan state the same rule

run:
import re, sys
s = open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
plan = s[s.find("## plan"):s.find("## start")]
step = next((ln for ln in plan.splitlines() if ln.startswith("6. ")), "")
ok = re.search(r"(?i)behaviou?r, not (?:its |their )?(?:internal )?shape", step) and re.search(r"(?i)same (?:function|code|file)", step)
print("step 6 of the plan step tells the planner to check shared code by its behaviour, not its shape:", bool(ok))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re, subprocess, sys
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/rag.py", "pack", "--root", "_self", "--set", "kb-sprint:plan"], capture_output=True, text=True)
ok = p.returncode == 0 and re.search(r"(?i)behaviou?r, not (?:its |their )?(?:internal )?shape", p.stdout)
print("the plan set of the sprint rules prints the behaviour-not-shape rule:", bool(ok), "(exit", p.returncode, ")")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: step 6 of the plan step of the kb-sprint skill tells the planner to give stories that change the same function checks on its behaviour, not on its internal shape, so a later story does not break an earlier done story's check

notes: Retrospective of SP-rmp5zm5a (2026-10-22, operator accepted): landing ST-o367qbqn broke ST-bbxlwm4b's check (asserted curl for an .html url), and landing ST-aml4xyrf broke ST-o367qbqn's (planted one argv per source); a done item's checks change only after a reopen. Premise run on main with python3 -c over skills/sprint/SKILL.md and over python3 _tools/rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-sprint:plan: check 0 prints 'step 6 of the plan step tells the planner to check shared code by its behaviour, not its shape: False' and check 1 prints 'the plan set of the sprint rules prints the behaviour-not-shape rule: False (exit 0 )'. The planner reads rules through the pack sets when kb_root is set, so the rule lives in kb/_self/backlog.md (Sprints, Plan) with a tested row in kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv in the set kb-sprint:plan, and in step 6 of skills/sprint/SKILL.md. The two sibling breaks: ST-bbxlwm4b's check asserted curl for an .html url and ST-o367qbqn's change broke it; ST-aml4xyrf's change broke ST-o367qbqn's check, which planted one argv per source.
